description: This file defines the BudgetService class which provides methods to access financial budget-related data from an API, such as summary, category breakdown, and trend analysis.

classes.name: BudgetService
classes.description: A service class that provides methods to fetch budget analytics data from an API.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Fetches a summary of the budget within optional start and end dates.

methods.name: byCategory
methods.description: Retrieves budget data broken down by category within optional date ranges.

methods.name: trend
methods.description: Gets trend points over time, with a default bucket of 'month', within optional date ranges.
